timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹424.11 Cr (+1.3% YoY), net profit ₹12.99 Cr (-82.7% YoY).

PNB Gilts Limited’s shareholders approved Sh. Bibhu Prasad Mahapatra (DIN: 08756848) and Smt. Anju Mittal (DIN: 11410994) as Non-Executive & Non-Independent Directors via postal ballot on March 25, 2026, with 99.99% approval.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹436.32 Cr (-1.6% YoY), net profit ₹44.84 Cr (against a loss of ₹45.35 Cr a year earlier).
